channel.title: The Librarian's Regimen
channel.description: Notes on health, nutrition and medicine, worked through one question at a time from the primary literature: what the studies actually found, how sure anyone can honestly be, and what that leaves a reasonable person to do. Written by a reader, not a clinician — nothing here is medical advice.

item.title: What a Kidney Stone Actually Is, and Why It Forms
item.description: About one adult in ten will make a kidney stone. Before the questions about water, calcium and what to eat, the first one: what a stone actually is, what it is made of, and why it forms in some kidneys and not others — read from the studies.
